phase: Reference-only protocol, frozen before any detector, segmenter or passenger model was run on these photos.
selection: Eight purpose-selected, provider-processed UAE windscreen photographs from eight separate drives absent from prior project studies. Photographs selected visually from a larger screened pool. The evaluator is an AI reviewer, without independent rider labels. Some similar roads and contributors recur.
scoring: One ordinary typed first turn per image. A proposal must put its point inside or on the premarked polygon. On a negative, the system must withhold coordinates and ask or declare insufficient visual evidence. A transport or model error never passes. A passenger confirmation or a manually placed pin never increases first-turn accuracy. For each missed positive, independently score a single scripted tap in the frozen region. This checks visible intent only. No available photograph establishes a safe or legal stop.
